page.overview:
Who is Cleftor?

Cleftor is a character who appears in Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door. He is a Hyper Bald Cleft with its own name and personality.

Cleftor's personality is the exact opposite of King K's. Cleftor doesn't care much about making friends as he considers everyone else opponents that need to be defeated in battle. Cleftor doesn't think much about Mario and even believes that Mario defeating his team was of pure luck on their end. However, Cleftor soon grows to respect Mario, especially after he saves the world and treats him much more nicely.

Cleftor is only seen at the Glitz Pit of Glitzville where he stays in the minor league room. He is the leader of his team, the Punk Rocks. Even after the events of the game, Cleftor, remains in the minor league room alongside King K. and Bandy Andy.
